name: Amti
instructions: 1. Pressure cook the toor dal with turmeric and water until soft, then mash it until smooth.
2. Soak tamarind in warm water, extract the pulp, and add it to the cooked dal along with jaggery.
3. Add goda masala and salt, bringing the mixture to a boil; adjust water to achieve a medium-thin consistency.
4. In a small pan, heat oil/ghee and add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves, and asafoetida.
5. Pour this tempering over the boiling dal and simmer for another 5 minutes.
6. Garnish with fresh coriander before serving hot with steamed rice.
description: Amti is the quintessential Maharashtrian dal, distinguished by the use of 'Goda Masala'—a complex, fragrant spice blend unique to the region. It is a staple in everyday Maharashtrian meals, balancing sweet (jaggery), tangy (tamarind), and spicy notes, embodying the soul of home-cooked comfort food.
